item.title: Iran Live Updates: Nearly 700,000 Flee Israeli Strikes in Lebanon
item.summary: Lebanese leaders and aid groups warned of a growing humanitarian crisis as Israel targeted Hezbollah. The Pentagon said 140 American service members had been wounded, eight severely, in the war.

item.title: Civilians Killed by Strikes in Gulf States Are Almost All Migrant Workers
item.summary: Since the American-Israeli attack on Iran began, at least 12 civilians have been killed in oil-rich Gulf countries. All but one of them were foreign nationals.

item.title: Fear and Hope for Iranians Trapped Between Bombs and Defiant Rulers
item.summary: Many in Iran feel helpless in the face of their entrenched system, and some are becoming increasingly embittered by the fierce American and Israeli bombardment.

item.title: Ukraine Helps U.S. Bases in the Mideast With Stopping Drones
item.summary: As the war in Iran spreads, Kyiv is eagerly offering its hard-won expertise and advanced technology to counter Iranian drones.

item.title: U.S. Showers Iran With Bombs in Most Intense Strikes of the War, Pentagon Says
item.summary: Iranians cowered under the barrage as Pete Hegseth, the U.S. defense secretary, said the U.S. aimed to wipe out Iran’s capacity to obtain nuclear weapons “forever.”

item.title: Imprisoned in Iran, and Under Bombardment
item.summary: Iranian detention centers, some holding people swept up in a government crackdown on protests along with other prisoners, have been damaged in the U.S.-Israeli airstrikes.

item.title: Pentagon Says 140 Service Members Have Been Injured in Iran War
item.summary: Eight Americans have been seriously wounded, military officials said, but the bulk of the injured have already returned to duty. Seven Americans have been killed.

item.title: How Long Will the Iran War Last? Trump Offers Conflicting Answers.
item.summary: Now 11 days into an expanding military campaign, President Trump and his officials have given conflicting indications on how long the United States intends the war to last.

item.title: France Bolsters Efforts to Repatriate Citizens Stranded by Iran War
item.summary: France is highlighting its repatriation operations for nationals left stranded by the conflict with Iran.

item.title: Nearly 700,000 Displaced by War in Lebanon, U.N. Says
item.summary: Mass evacuation orders and an intensifying Israeli bombing campaign targeting the Iran-backed militia Hezbollah have caused a humanitarian crisis, aid groups warn.
